data.cultural_impact: The name "Sharajan" derives from the Sanskrit language, a significant influence in Hindu culture. The name honors the deep reverence for the divine, specifically "shara" translating to 'Lord' or 'God'. This name offers a reminder of our connection to the divine and emphasizes the importance of devotion and faith.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual meaning of "Sharajan" is rooted in the acknowledgment of the supreme power that governs the universe. "Janan" means 'Of the Universe', the divine belonging to which we all are a part.
